tools.name: sellsy_search
tools.description: Free-text search over companies, individuals, contacts, opportunities, items, documents and staff in one call (GET /search). Use it to find a record by name, email or number when you do not know its type. Needs the search.read scope.

tools.name: sellsy_list_companies
tools.description: List companies (customers, prospects, suppliers) with paging. Needs companies.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_companies
tools.description: Search companies by name, email, type (prospect/client/supplier), reference, VAT, SIRET, country, postal code, creation or update date. Needs companies.read.

tools.name: sellsy_get_company
tools.description: Get one company by id. Needs companies.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_company_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts linked to one company (GET /companies/{id}/contacts). Needs companies.read and contacts.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_individuals
tools.description: List individuals (private customers, prospects, suppliers) with paging. Needs individuals.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_individuals
tools.description: Search individuals by name, email, type, reference, country, postal code, creation or update date. Needs individuals.read.

tools.name: sellsy_get_individual
tools.description: Get one individual by id. Needs individuals.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people at companies) with paging. Needs contacts.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by last name, email, phone, linked company or individual, creation date. Needs contacts.read.

tools.name: sellsy_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id. Needs contacts.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_opportunities
tools.description: List sales opportunities with paging. Needs opportunities.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_opportunities
tools.description: Search opportunities by name, number, pipeline, step, status (open/won/lost/cancelled/closed/late), amount, owner or due date. Needs opportunities.read.

tools.name: sellsy_get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one opportunity by id. Needs opportunities.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_opportunity_pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines (needed to create an opportunity: pipeline id and step id). Needs opportunities.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_pipeline_steps
tools.description: List the steps of one opportunity pipeline. Needs opportunities.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes) with paging. Needs estimates.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_estimates
tools.description: Search estimates by status, number, date, currency, owner, contact or related company/individual/opportunity. Needs estimates.read.

tools.name: sellsy_get_estimate
tools.description: Get one estimate by id, with its rows and amounts. Needs estimates.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with paging. Needs invoices.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_invoices
tools.description: Search invoices by status (draft/due/payinprogress/paid/late/cancelled), number, date, currency, owner, or related company/individual/opportunity. Use it for unpaid or late invoices. Needs invoices.read.

tools.name: sellsy_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with its rows, amounts and status. Needs invoices.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List the payments linked to one invoice. Needs invoices.read and payments.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with paging. Needs orders.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_orders
tools.description: Search orders by status or delivery status, or related company/individual/opportunity. Needs orders.read.

tools.name: sellsy_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id. Needs orders.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_credit_notes
tools.description: List credit notes with paging. Needs credit-notes.read.

tools.name: sellsy_get_credit_note
tools.description: Get one credit note by id. Needs credit-notes.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_items
tools.description: List catalog items (products, services, shipping, packaging) with paging. Needs items.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_items
tools.description: Search catalog items by name, reference or type. Needs items.read.

tools.name: sellsy_get_item
tools.description: Get one catalog item by id. Needs items.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_payments
tools.description: Search payments by status (pending/confirmed/rejected/failed/refund) or related company/individual. Needs payments.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with paging. Needs tasks.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks by status (todo/done), owner, assignee, label, due date or related record. Needs tasks.read.

tools.name: sellsy_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id. Needs tasks.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_task_labels
tools.description: List the task labels (a label id is required to create a task). Needs tasks.read.

tools.name: sellsy_search_comments
tools.description: Search comments and notes by author, date, parent comment or the company/individual/contact they are attached to. Needs comments.read.

tools.name: sellsy_list_staffs
tools.description: List the staff members of the account (the list may hold only yourself, depending on the Sellsy plan). Needs staffs.read.

tools.name: sellsy_create_company
tools.description: WRITE: create a company record in Sellsy (a prospect, client or supplier). Needs companies.write. Nothing is sent to the company.

tools.name: sellsy_create_individual
tools.description: WRITE: create an individual (a private person as prospect, client or supplier) in Sellsy. Needs individuals.write.

tools.name: sellsy_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact (a person) in Sellsy. It is not linked to a company by this call. Needs contacts.write.

tools.name: sellsy_create_opportunity
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales opportunity linked to a company, individual or contact. Needs a pipeline id and one of its step ids (see sellsy_list_opportunity_pipelines and sellsy_list_pipeline_steps). Needs opportunities.write.

tools.name: sellsy_create_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment (note) to a company, individual, contact, opportunity or document. Visible to the Sellsy staff, not sent to the customer. Needs comments.write.

tools.name: sellsy_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task, optionally attached to a record and assigned to staff. Needs a label id (see sellsy_list_task_labels) and a due date-time. Needs tasks.write.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sellsy_search, sellsy_search_companies, sellsy_search_individuals, sellsy_search_contacts, sellsy_search_comments · Private data: sellsy_search, sellsy_list_company_contacts, sellsy_list_individuals, sellsy_list_contacts, sellsy_search_contacts, sellsy_get_contact, sellsy_search_estimates, sellsy_search_tasks, sellsy_search_comments, sellsy_create_company, sellsy_create_individual, sellsy_create_contact, sellsy_create_opportunity, sellsy_create_comment, sellsy_create_task · Public sink: sellsy_search, sellsy_search_companies, sellsy_search_individuals, sellsy_search_contacts, sellsy_create_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sellsy_search, sellsy_search_companies, sellsy_search_individuals, sellsy_search_contacts, sellsy_search_comments · Private data: sellsy_search, sellsy_list_company_contacts, sellsy_list_individuals, sellsy_list_contacts, sellsy_search_contacts, sellsy_get_contact, sellsy_search_estimates, sellsy_search_tasks, sellsy_search_comments, sellsy_create_company, sellsy_create_individual, sellsy_create_contact, sellsy_create_opportunity, sellsy_create_comment, sellsy_create_task · Public sink: sellsy_search, sellsy_search_companies, sellsy_search_individuals, sellsy_search_contacts, sellsy_create_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
